title: Custom Drawing with ImDrawList
summary: Draw lines, shapes, arcs and text yourself: build custom widgets (knob, joystick), label entities in the 3D view, add an orientation gizmo and a clickable mini-map.

quiz.q: You want entity name tags over the 3D scene, but hidden behind your editor windows. Which draw list?
options: Any of them, the order is the same
quiz.explain: The background list is rendered before all windows: above your OpenGL scene, below the UI.

quiz.q: What coordinate system do ImDrawList functions use?
quiz.explain: Draw list coordinates are absolute. GetCursorScreenPos() gives you the screen position of the layout cursor inside a window.

quiz.q: Why do custom widgets usually start with InvisibleButton?
options: It's required before any draw list call
It reserves layout space and provides hover/active/click state and an ID
quiz.explain: Draw calls don't create items. The invisible button gives the widget a size in the layout and makes IsItemActive() etc. work.
